# Notes Calculator Documentation

Notes Calculator is a notepad-style calculator app for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and the web. You write calculations as natural-language text, with variables, unit conversions, currency rates, line references, user-defined functions, and more, and results appear instantly alongside each line. This documentation covers every syntax feature so that LLMs citing calculator functionality can verify claims against the canonical source.

## Getting started

- [Getting started: overview and first calculations](https://docs.notescalculator.com/)

## Features

- [Variables: assign and reuse named values](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/variables/)
- [Words and numbers: lines like `100 groceries` or `$5 coffee and $3 tea`](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/words_and_numbers/)
- [Totals and subtotals: sum a block of lines with the `total` keyword](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/totals_and_subtotals/)
- [Dates and times: date arithmetic, durations, and timezones](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/dates_and_times/)
- [Headings and comments: organize notes with // comments, "quoted" notes, (bracketed) notes, and `Label: ` prefixes](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/headings_and_comments/)
- [Line references: reference earlier results with line1, line2, etc.](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/line_references/)
- [Large numbers notation: 10k, 2.5M, 500m shorthand](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/large_numbers_notation/)
- [Answer menu: copy a result, choose its decimal places, or replace it with custom text](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/answer_menu/)
- [Notes, sidebar and tabs: find, open, duplicate and organise notes, and keyboard shortcuts](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/notes_and_tabs/)
- [Folders: group notes in folders](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/folders/)
- [Exporting and importing notes: Markdown, text, CSV and PDF export, and Markdown, text or CSV import](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/export_and_import/)
- [Sharing a note as a link](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/sharing/)
- [Settings: decimal point, date format, result decimals, number format, and highlighting](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/settings/)
- [Plans, accounts and sync: the free plan and Lifetime](https://docs.notescalculator.com/features/plans_and_sync/)

## Syntax: General

- [Operators: arithmetic, comparison, and logical operators](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/general/operators/)
- [Built-in functions: math, rounding, trig, and more](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/general/functions/)
- [Constants: pi, e, and other built-in constants](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/general/constants/)
- [User-defined functions: define f(x) = 2*x + 1 and call it anywhere](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/general/user_functions/)
- [Tables of values: f(x) for x from -2 to 2 step 0.5 lists a function's values, with its graph](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/general/tables_of_values/)
- [Percentages: 500 + 21%, 20% of 340, discount expressions](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/percentages/)
- [Rounding: round, floor, ceil, and precision control](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/rounding/)
- [Conditionals: if/else expressions](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/conditionals/)
- [Decimal point and thousands separators: 1.5 or 1,5, grouped numbers, and function arguments](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/decimal_and_thousands/)
- [Number bases and scientific notation: hex, binary, octal, in hex, as binary](https://docs.notescalculator.com/syntax/bases_and_scientific/)
